reauth.body: Completing this flow replaces the stored credentials for the flagged connection and resumes syncing. Re-enter the Client ID and Client Secret for the same {platform} seller account from your developer app - the connection and its mappings are preserved. The Environment and Product catalogue selections below do not change the existing connection's configuration; only the credentials are rotated.
reauth.title: Re-authenticating an existing connection

translateAllegroError.afterSalesRequired: Set after-sales policies (returns, warranty, implied warranty) on the connection-edit page or directly on the offer. The marketplace requires them for business accounts.
translateAllegroError.noSafetyInformationNotAllowed: This category requires substantive safety information. Edit the connection and choose 'Provide safety information (text)' with category-relevant content (battery warnings, age restrictions, CE/RoHS, etc.).
translateAllegroError.responsibleProducerMissing: Set a responsible producer in the connection's seller defaults.
translateAllegroError.safetyInfoNotDefined: The marketplace rejected the safety information for this category. Check the safety information type and save the connection's seller defaults again. If the issue persists, the category likely needs written safety information rather than the "no safety information" option.
translateAllegroError.taxRateMissing: No tax rate is known for this product, so the offer cannot state what tax it charges. Add the rate in the shop's catalogue and re-sync the product.
translateAllegroError.taxRateNotAllowed: {reason} Correct the rate in the shop and re-sync the product; OpenLinker never publishes an offer with the rate omitted.
translateAllegroError.taxRateNotAllowedDefault: This marketplace category does not allow the tax rate on this product.
translateAllegroError.taxRateNotExpressible: This channel cannot express the tax code on this product. Set a rate the channel supports, or list the product where the code is supported.
translateAllegroError.unknownField: OpenLinker sent a field the marketplace does not recognise. Try again later; if it keeps failing, contact support with the offer ID.
translateAllegroError.unknownFieldAt: OpenLinker sent a field the marketplace does not recognise at `{field}`. Try again later; if it keeps failing, contact support with the offer ID.
translateAllegroError.unsupportedLanguage: OpenLinker sent a language setting the marketplace does not support. Try again later; if it keeps failing, contact support.
